title: We Broke Minecraft's Largest Storage
description:
Wavetechs main storage has been up and running for a few months now and I've always wanted to do a video going through the nitty gritty of how to maintain such an important piece of infrastructure. It just so happens that Wavetechs main storage encountered a catastrophic failure so let's go inside and discover what went wrong and how to prevent it in the future.
